source.title: Power of da Earth
source.description: Ta make the ground rumble will require a strong connection to de earth. De Badlands be filt wit stones and boulders hardened by time. De embodiments of earth roam these lands and call it home.
source.objective: Collect 5 Rumbling Essence from the rock elementals in Badlands and bring them to Bath'rah the Windwatcher in Alterac Mountains.
source.progress: You' legs be lookin' a wobbly der. De ground be shakin?
source.completion: Let's get ready to rumble, ya?
